// ServiceAuth: Shared secret for service-to-service calls to internal endpoints (e.g. GET v1/auth/internal/author-profiles/{id}). Empty here on purpose: provide via env ServiceAuth__Token in every shared/production environment. When empty, only a valid JWT is accepted.

AuthSettings.// SecretKey: Placeholder only. Never commit a real signing key here. Provide it via environment variable (e.g. GcpSettings__AuthSettings__SecretKey) or GCP Secret Manager, per auth-guidelines.md section 12.

GoogleAuthSettings.// ClientId: Public OAuth client id (embedded in the frontend); not a secret. The client secret is not used by the ID-token flow and must never be committed.
